mapper.select: SELECT f.*, b.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name, b.material_code, b.project_no, b.material_name, b.customer_item, b.project_material_sku, b.product_index_no, b.glove_size, b.color AS color_code, b.uom AS main_uom, b.specification, b.model FROM inventory_snapshot_fact f JOIN warehouse_sku_base b ON b.warehouse_sku_key = f.warehouse_sku_key JOIN warehouse w ON w.warehouse_id = b.warehouse_id b.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} ORDER BY f.stock_date DESC, b.project_no, b.material_code
